$comment: Which paths the website answers. Everything else goes to the Aetheria app. Paths must not collide with app routes (for example the app owns /patients, /auth, /portal, /dashboard, /my-record, /api).

demoRoles.$comment: Personas /demo/enter?role= accepts, and where each lands. Software admin is internal and deliberately absent.

signIn.$comment: In the demo the website's /login is the only sign-in page. A full GET of these exact app paths is redirected there (?idle=1 is carried over). Deeper paths such as /auth/callback and /auth/reset stay with the app. Set DEMO_SIGNIN_REDIRECT=false to switch this off in front of a live app.

hostRoots.$comment: When a custom domain is attached later: the root of these hosts redirects into the right portal.
